title: Nourishing Smoky Polish Portobello Skewers
description: A fresh and chewy Polish dish featuring prosciutto and shio-koji-cure, perfect for a crowd, and can be made plant-based-friendly by substituting prosciutto with a plant-based alternative.

ingredients.name: portobello mushrooms
ingredients.notes: stems removed and caps sliced 1/2 inch thick

instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together shio-koji, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced portobello mushrooms to the bowl and toss to coat with the shio-koji mixture.
Thread a mushroom slice, a prosciutto slice, and a sprinkle of parsley onto each skewer, repeating until all ingredients are used.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the mushrooms are tender and the prosciutto is crispy.
Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving.
